newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE COFFEE WEAKER IN LIGHT TRADE, SPREADS CITED.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE COFFEE WEAKER IN LIGHT TRADE, SPREADS CITED.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures drifted lower after pressure from a mixed bag of sellers as spot September prepared to challenge psychological support at $1,600, traders said on Tuesday.
Although nearby spreads attracted some dealing interest the differentials were broadly unchanged from the previous session. Sept/Nov was reported to be hovering around $5 and Nov/Jan at around $22.
A mixed bag of players was present on both sides of the market but traders said volume and ranges were unimpressive.
At the midday break September was down $25 at $1,605 and November down $19 at $1,611. Volume was 1,911 lots.
Market sources said London appeared unable to sustain much of a rally at present with switches generating the most interest and volume in the market.

With nearby positions weighed down with untenderable coffees and slack manufacturer demand due to seasonal holidays, the rangebound pattern was likely to continue for a while yet. Tenderable coffees were tightly held.
Earlier, technical analysts said upward momentum was lacking and so unless a rally came soon the market was in danger of another slide.
Prices also faced resistance in the form of the trading band between mid-June and mid-July, approximately from $1,700 to $1,900, they added.
